title: Spring Shoes jump
description: The player jumps at a ledge three blocks up and falls well short. He picks up spring shoes, jumps again, catches the ledge's edge, and climbs up to the gold bar on it, then jumps on the spot, nearly three blocks high, and lands unhurt.
